name: Benventures
author: Bigbigvagg
description: This is my first game. It is a parkour, riddle and action game. The concept is very simple you are a bean and lost your can. Your objective is to find your way back to the can and survive the deadly obstacles. Quote: As wise man once said "Beans" - Dani.    Version 1.1: Changed level 2 a little so that the game is lighter and loads faster.
